artifact.baseImage: localhost/bunny-os-retained-base:1f08084a (locked upstream sha256:c466de53, sourced from the verified retention mirror; upstream digest no longer served)
artifact.discoveryArtifact: 72ff8063 / qcow2 7d840788… — the run that found the defects; its record is evidence/discovery/

environment.builder: Fedora Linux 44 (WSL2), QEMU/KVM guest, 4 vCPU, 6144 MiB, llvmpipe
environment.audio: intel-hda + hda-micro; host wav audiodev records the emulated speaker; microphone is a PipeWire pipe-source fed by a hold-open daemon
environment.caveat: no physical speaker or microphone anywhere in the chain; no human has heard any audio

legend.PASS: evidence recorded for this artifact and commit
legend.FAIL: evidence of failure recorded; defect ledger entry references it
legend.NOT_RUN: no evidence for this candidate; prior-phase evidence does not transfer
legend.NOT_SUPPORTED: the product does not support this by design; reason recorded

rows.requirement: Microphone discovered; graph default agrees with companion inventory
rows.evidence: logs/mic-prepare.log, logs/voice-health.log (pipewire+pulse backends both name bunny-virtual-microphone default; STT_READY)

rows.requirement: Activation permitted only from the closed activation-source set; indicator raised while handle open
rows.evidence: runs/states-ee1.ndjson (Microphone active names), runs/truth-ee1.ndjson; source set closed by companion/speech/request.py and asserted in the suite

rows.requirement: Speech captured and recognized from the default device
rows.evidence: every transcript in logs/final-run.log; confidence 1.0 on canonical phrases

rows.requirement: Silence settles as no-speech and returns to idle
rows.evidence: logs/silence.log — 'I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?' → finished(warning), no task created

rows.requirement: No capture device present: controlled error, reason named, retry offered
rows.evidence: logs/vi-novirt.log — 'the input device was lost; no transcript could be preserved; typed input remains available and no task was created'. Tested as selected-device-absent; a zero-device machine is unbuildable here (the emulated HDA capture always exists)
rows.note: zero-capture-device variant NOT_RUN on this rig

rows.requirement: Device lost mid-capture: interaction ends with device-loss reason, indicator clears
rows.evidence: logs/vi-disconnect.log — pipe-source unloaded mid-listen; contract sentence verbatim; microphone active:false events

rows.requirement: Device returns: next interaction succeeds without restart
rows.evidence: logs/vi-reconnect.log — rig re-armed, transcript 1.0, success; no companion restart

rows.requirement: Two microphones present: the selected one is captured from
rows.evidence: logs/mic-prepare.log — HDA capture and virtual mic both inventoried; capture followed the selected default (transcripts prove the virtual source; the HDA line is silent)
rows.note: per-request deviceId override NOT_RUN; selection-by-default is the shipped path

rows.requirement: Silent-but-present microphone settles as no-speech, not a hang
rows.evidence: logs/silence.log (daemon-fed silence → no-speech) and logs/hda-silent.log (emulated HDA capture yields no stream → device-lost error, no hang; recovery in logs/after-hda.log)

rows.requirement: Background noise: speech over noise recognized; noise alone not accepted as speech
rows.evidence: logs/noise.log (noise-only → no false accept) and logs/noisy.log (speech over noise transcribed degraded: 'how much memory and i use it', 0.81 — captured, recognition quality reduced; recorded as a model limitation in the ledger)

rows.requirement: Short command transcribed
rows.evidence: logs/final-run.log — 'open files' 1.0, 'open terminal' 1.0

rows.requirement: Normal conversational sentence transcribed
rows.evidence: logs/final-run.log — 'how much memory am i using' 1.0, 'find pdf files in downloads' 1.0

rows.requirement: Long multi-clause speech transcribed without truncation
rows.evidence: logs/long.log — 21 words verbatim at 0.988

rows.requirement: Recognition failure (unrecognizable input) settles honestly, not as a wrong accept
rows.evidence: logs/german.log — German speech transcribed as English gibberish at 0.60, agent answers its capabilities text, flow settles success; confidence is not a rejection gate (ledger)

rows.requirement: STT unavailable (model absent): readiness names the reason; voice input refused; text unaffected
rows.evidence: voice_health readinessState vocabulary (STT_MODEL_MISSING/CORRUPT/RUNTIME_MISSING) exercised by suite; on-image readiness STT_READY in logs/voice-health.log; the E2E milestone's uid-namespace variant of this failure is the regression tests' origin
rows.note: model-hidden live run executed in the speech-input phase; not repeated on this artifact

rows.requirement: Accidental activation (press, say nothing): cancel or timeout, no task submitted
rows.evidence: logs/silence.log — 60 s listen with nothing queued: warning + finished(warning), no task id issued

rows.requirement: Multiple consecutive requests all recognized (>=3)
rows.evidence: logs/consecutive.log — three flows, transcripts 1.0 each, replies spoken

rows.requirement: Per-request latency recorded (capture end -> transcript)
rows.evidence: logs/latency.json — utterance-end→thinking 2.1–2.9 s across five runs

rows.requirement: Confirmed transcript reaches the runtime through the same submit path as typed input
rows.evidence: code path asserted by suite (speech_input_confirm → _submit_runtime_task); live: voice and typed tasks in one session record, logs/sessions.log

rows.requirement: Session parity: consecutive voice tasks and a typed task share one session record
rows.evidence: logs/sessions.log — one 'Bunny Desktop' session, 16 tasks including the typed one; on-disk store agrees

rows.requirement: Cross-task conversational memory
rows.evidence: discovery/logs/closeit.log — 'Now close it.' falls to the capabilities text; equal for voice and text (agent context carries same-task operations only)

rows.requirement: Sensitive action raises the approval question; Allow proceeds
rows.evidence: logs/ee1-drive.log + screens/ee1-03-approval.png — launch_application approval raised on screen and allowed; action executed

rows.requirement: Deny leaves the action unexecuted and the system usable
rows.evidence: logs/deny.log — decision denied → blocked 'Declined; nothing was done.' → no terminal process or window; later flows unaffected

rows.requirement: Approved action verifiably completed (process/unit/bus/window signals)
rows.evidence: logs/ee1-verify.log — nautilus process, dbus unit, bus name, showing frame (0,0,890,550)

rows.requirement: Response generated; the provider that spoke is named in the event stream
rows.evidence: speech_started providerId=pocket throughout logs/final-run.log; kitten named in the fallback case

rows.requirement: Audio audibly played: the emulated speaker's recording is non-silent and recognizable
rows.evidence: logs/ee1-recognise.log — played.wav non-zero, recognized back as 'files is open'

rows.requirement: Playback completion observed from the sink, character leaves SPEAKING
rows.evidence: runs/truth-mem.ndjson + runs/states-mem.ndjson — talking claim ends with sink/player activity (0 violations)

rows.requirement: Playback interrupted < 250 ms to silence; nothing plays afterwards
rows.evidence: logs/interrupt.log — cancel answered with the cancelled request id; audio stopped 130 ms after the cancel (pw-play + last-column sink state); sink SUSPENDED, players 0 afterwards. Broken on the discovery artifact (voice_cancel refused); fixed at c1cbf98f

rows.requirement: Preferred provider unavailable: fallback provider named, configured preference unchanged
rows.evidence: logs/fallback.log — pocket hidden, speech_started providerId=kitten, flow success

rows.requirement: All providers unavailable: text answer intact, never enters SPEAKING, no crash
rows.evidence: logs/notts.log — reply intact, warning 'no eligible local voice provider; the caption is the whole of the output', success in 11 s wall. On the discovery artifact this took 70+ s of silent waiting; fixed at c1cbf98f (bridge)

rows.requirement: Long response spoken to completion
rows.evidence: logs/final-run.log restored + capabilities replies; discovery/logs (capabilities reply spoken end-to-end in interrupt setup runs)

rows.requirement: Consecutive responses each spoken; no queue wedge
rows.evidence: logs/consecutive.log — three spoken replies back-to-back, each speech_finished

rows.requirement: Audio output device unavailable: error path, text preserved, recovery to idle
rows.evidence: worker path no-audio-device-at-startup settles degraded-to-captions (suite-asserted); live variant: all-providers case preserves the text and settles (logs/notts.log)
rows.note: live sink-removal mid-playback NOT_RUN — destroying the only emulated sink is not recoverable on this rig

rows.requirement: PRIMARY GATE: pointer press on the visible microphone button -> speak -> understand -> approve -> act -> respond -> idle, on the exact artifact
rows.evidence: logs/ee1-drive.log, screens/ee1-*.png, logs/ee1-verify.log, logs/ee1-recognise.log; runs/voice-ee1.json transitions listening +0.7s → success +24.2s

rows.requirement: Truthfulness: listening claim iff capture handle open; speaking claim iff player/sink active
rows.evidence: logs/ee1-truth.json, mem, pdfs, uistop — all PASS; zero capture streams outside claimed listening in every run

rows.requirement: After every failure case, the next normal interaction succeeds
rows.evidence: logs/postint.log (after interrupt), logs/restored.log (after no-TTS), logs/after-hda.log and vi-reconnect.log (after device loss)

rows.requirement: Offline end-to-end: spoken command completes with every non-loopback link down
rows.evidence: logs/offline.log — link down, ping unreachable; approval granted; 'Terminal is open.' spoken by pocket; terminal process verified

rows.requirement: Voice interruption end-to-end: user stops Bunny mid-speech, can immediately speak again
rows.evidence: logs/interrupt.log (130 ms) + logs/postint.log (next interaction spoken, 21 s whole-flow wall) + logs/uistop-drive.log with runs/truth-uistop.ndjson (the on-screen control, truthful)

rows.requirement: Prerendered mode shows listening/thinking/speaking during a spoken flow
rows.evidence: runs/states-*.ndjson + screens/ee1-01-listening.png, ee1-02-talking.png — the shipping character reflects the semantic states on screen

rows.requirement: 2D procedural mode shows the same semantic states
rows.evidence: runs/slice-vr.json — the installed voice-renderer slice drives the real VisemeLink/renderer join: 4 distinct mouth shapes, ordered frames, revision-carrying, neutral on completion/cancel/restart (16/18 PASS, 2 honest NOT_RUN)
rows.note: mode-specific pixel evidence NOT_RUN (compositor probe needs a display); state contract is renderer-agnostic and slice-proven on the artifact

rows.requirement: 3D mode shows the same semantic states
rows.evidence: same slice contract (set_mouth_shape and display_state are total across all five renderers, suite-asserted); 3D-specific runtime evidence from the 3D phase stands at library level
rows.note: on-artifact 3D pixel run NOT_RUN (llvmpipe headless); the mode ladder itself is suite-covered

rows.requirement: Mode change during a voice interaction leaves a defined, truthful presentation
rows.evidence: code inspection (controller.set_mode never calls the links' restart_renderer); not reachable in the shipped window, which renders one mode — recorded in the ledger as a library-level defect for the renderer phase
rows.note: documented, deliberately unfixed in Stage 2: the shipped surface renders a single mode

rows.requirement: Idle companion settles to quiescent (no per-frame work)
rows.evidence: logs/cpu-idle.json — companion 0.27% of one core over 60 s idle, neural worker 0.0%

rows.requirement: Activation wakes it promptly; wake-to-LISTENING latency recorded
rows.evidence: runs/voice-*.json — press→visible LISTENING 0.6–0.8 s in every run

rows.requirement: Voice-active states never quiesce (LISTENING/TRANSCRIBING/SPEAKING/WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL)
rows.evidence: NEVER_QUIESCENT set in companion/character/quiescence.py, cross-checked against attention._MAY_QUIESCE by suite; live: states animate through every flow (states ndjson)
